_comment: High/critical advisories accepted by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. This list may only shrink. Each entry: why it is not reachable at runtime, and the work that removes it.

accepted.title: adm-zip: Crafted ZIP file triggers 4GB memory allocation
accepted.reason: Sanity CLI 3.99 (@sanity/runtime-cli pins adm-zip ^0.5.16). CLI-only, never runs on Vercel or in the sites.

accepted.title: adm-zip: Uncontrolled memory allocation via the declared uncompressed size (DoS)
accepted.reason: Sanity CLI 3.99 (@sanity/runtime-cli pins adm-zip ^0.5.16). CLI-only, never runs on Vercel or in the sites.

accepted.title: adm-zip: Decompression-bomb protection (fix for CVE-2026-39244) can be bypassed by declaring uncompressed size as 0
accepted.reason: Sanity CLI 3.99 (@sanity/runtime-cli pins adm-zip ^0.5.16). CLI-only, never runs on Vercel or in the sites.

accepted.title: adm-zip extraction preserves SUID/SGID bits from untrusted ZIPs -> local privilege escalation
accepted.reason: Sanity CLI 3.99 (@sanity/runtime-cli pins adm-zip ^0.5.16). CLI-only, never runs on Vercel or in the sites.

accepted.title: adm-zip: Unhandled error event in async DEFLATE decompression crashes Node.js process (DoS)
accepted.reason: Sanity CLI 3.99 (@sanity/runtime-cli pins adm-zip ^0.5.16). CLI-only, never runs on Vercel or in the sites.

accepted.title: Decompress: Archive extraction can create files and links outside of the target directory
accepted.reason: Sanity CLI 3.99 (@sanity/cli). No fixed release exists. CLI-only archive extraction on developer machines.

accepted.title: @xhmikosr/decompress: Path traversal via symlink chain
accepted.reason: Sanity CLI 3.99 (@sanity/cli). No fixed release exists. CLI-only archive extraction on developer machines.

accepted.title: glob CLI: Command injection via -c/--cmd executes matches with shell:true
accepted.reason: Sanity CLI 3.99 (@architect/utils pins glob ~10.3.12). Advisory is in the glob command-line tool (-c flag), not the library.

accepted.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
accepted.reason: zod 3.x nested under @sanity/codegen and the shadcn CLI. The app does not import zod.
